channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NASA powers up Roman's 300-megapixel camera
item.description: NASA's Roman Space Telescope activated its 300-megapixel infrared camera, designed to capture vast stretches of the cosmos.

item.title: Chronic stress may quietly reshape the heart
item.description: Chronic inflammation linked to stress, lifestyle, mental health, and socioeconomic conditions may alter the heart for years before symptoms appear.

item.title: New process converts plastic waste into gasoline and diesel
item.description: Researchers at Oak Ridge National Laboratory have found a simple method to convert polyethylene, the plastic used in shopping bags, into fuel.

item.title: Needle-thin brain implant performs three functions simultaneously
item.description: A flexible fiber implant can record neural activity, deliver drugs, and stimulate multiple brain regions at once.
